title: GHG (greenhouse gas) emissions measurement
description: Runtime grams CO2e measurement attached to an order fulfillment. Category-1: content is a free-form uint256 grams value, not cross-checked against the agreement. Pair with any figaro-ghg-<standard>-v1 sister schema (figaro-ghg-protocol-v1, figaro-ghg-iso-14064-v1, figaro-ghg-pas-2050-v1, figaro-ghg-en-16258-v1, figaro-ghg-custom-v1) when the standard and scope of accounting need to be committed at contract time.

fields.name: grams
fields.description: Grams CO2e measured for this fulfillment. Decimal string (bigint-parseable). No upper bound enforced on-chain — callers responsible for unit sanity.
